source.description:
Zhu Yuexin (Pigheadskin) at a Table

Zhu Yuexin, better known by his stage name Pigheadskin, is seated at a table wearing a red track jacket and rectangular glasses. He is focused on a colorful magazine spread, holding it open as he reads. In front of him are name placards, indicating a formal setting such as a press event or panel discussion.

The image is sourced from a Taiwanese artist profile page, which lists both his Chinese name 朱約信 and his stage name 朱頭皮 (Pigheadskin). The casual yet organized scene highlights the musician’s engagement with printed material during a public appearance.

Zhu Toupi’s Controversial Lottery Shop Post

Taiwanese singer Zhu Toupi, also known as Zhu Yuexin, sparked controversy by posting a photo of a lottery shop overflowing with customers during the Lunar New Year. source.description:
Zhu Tóupí’s 30th Anniversary Reflections

Veteran Taiwanese singer Zhu Tóupí discusses his upcoming gratitude concert on June 26 at Taipei’s Huashan Legacy, celebrating three decades in music. He recounts his early days participating in student movements and leading the New Taiwanese Folk Song movement, which broadened Taiwan’s musical diversity. Zhu emphasizes that the freedom he enjoys on stage is built on the sacrifices of democratic pioneers, and he remains committed to opening doors for younger artists.
